title: Playboy Magazine April 1973 Tennessee Williams Interview Linda Lovelace Hit Man
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue showing heavier wear than average, priced accordingly. The spine is splitting at the bottom and the page block is visible at the lower spine end (shown in the close-up photo). The lower left corner is chipped with paper loss, and the left edge has rubbing and small tears. Cover shows toning and general edge and corner wear. No mailing label. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you. Please review the photos closely for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, April 1973 issue. Cover price one dollar.

Features:
- The Playboy Interview with Tennessee Williams
- "Deep Throat's" Linda Lovelace - the pictorial that ran while the film was still in its first-run notoriety
- Confessions of a Hit Man
- What They're Doing with Your Taxes

The cover is the "Special Delivery" design - lips, tongue and a 60-cent rabbit-head postage stamp - one of the more recognizable Playboy covers of the early seventies.

The back cover carries a 1973 Panasonic Series 44 ad introducing the RE-7740 four-channel receiver, with the matching 8-track deck and CD-4 record changer.

Condition: pre-owned reading copy with real wear - see the condition note and the close-up photo before buying.
